item.tib: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba
item.skt: Ar+ya many+dzu shrI nA ma saM gI ti sA d+ha nA ma
item.coloph: 'phags pa 'jam dpal gyi mtshan yang dag par brjod pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs/ u rgyan gyi slob dpon shrI a wa d+hu tI pa chen pos mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar gyi mkhan po d+harmA shrI mi tra dang / bod kyi lo tsA ba dge slong chos kyi bzang pos bsgyur ba'o//
